effects: Exactly one previously durably accounted host replicated observation; no hidden retries, batching, extra observations, query/proxy substitution, funding or mutation.
Reconstructed pending state cannot prove no previous dispatch or authorize repeating a lost observation. Additional calls require independent prior durable accounting.
Failures/drop/death preserve spent pending observation and mutation, obligations and source references. Lost replies cannot produce a settled Uncertain outcome.

Passive local late-reply association leaves both original attempts pending and writes no receipt. Status/controllers or zero/one/multiple snapshots never automatically prove Applied/NotApplied/Uncertain, permission, drain/load safety or exclusive capture attribution.
Terminal replay invokes no provider. No installed provider/transport/runner, automatic refund/restart or terminal/fence/reference release is introduced.
kind: ephemeral exact originally reserved IC recovery observation port; no persisted authority schema

request.admission: Integrations own durable originals, actual context/method-specific current read permissions, original recovery chronology and exclusive dispatch/command custody proving this observation was never dispatched. Structural binding is no permit or reissue authority.
request.bytes: Exact management receiver, effective target, closed method and host replicated update Candid bytes, within existing 4096-byte argument limit. Not a fresh-preflight reservation API.
request.original: Full original plan and operation authority, immutable allowances and exact original mutation payload plus independently retained canonical observation payload.
request.reservation: Require both original pending attempt IDs and exact already reserved observation digest. Reuse IcManagementRequestRecord::validate_mutation_binding/validate_observation_binding and AttemptJournalRecord. No new digest, journal, intent record or spending owner.

response.association: Recheck current original reservation, full authority, both attempt IDs, exact observation payload digest and actual claimed network/caller/release/target. Opaque evidence and claims require independent authentication/timing/attribution qualification.
response.bounds: Chronological 1 <= mutation_attempt < observation_attempt <= 1024; canonical target; raw reply <=1048576 bytes derived from both existing codec owners. No Default/Serde admission; Debug redacts raw bytes.
response.wire: Reuse IcSnapshotReply inventory and IcLifecycleReply status decoding, existing raw-ID/metadata/controller/type-table/work ceilings and exact request/raw-reply digests. No additional codec or evidence hash.
